text.description_html:
Acorn AH2BQ, 3 Inch Offset Smooth Iron Cabinet Hinges

This "H" style cabinet hinge installs in with just a few easy screws. The smooth iron finish surface hardware is typical of early American styling, with a flat black appearance which simulates the hardware as it may have looked originally if it was forged a century ago.

Specifications of the Smooth Iron H Cabinet Hinges:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Height: 3"
  • Width: 1-11/16"
  • 3/8" Offset Hinge: Door face sits 3/8" out from the door frame.

Sold as a pair (2-hinges)
